provider: Hugging Face ZeroGPU Spaces (public Spaces called through the Gradio client)
category: inference via hosted demos, GPU quota

free_tier.stated: ZeroGPU Spaces are available to use for free to all users: 2 minutes of GPU a day unauthenticated and 5 minutes a day on a free account, reset exactly 24 hours after the first GPU usage
free_tier.notes: the model served is whatever the Space's author runs; the quota counts GPU time of the function call, and the xlarge size costs twice the quota

interface_detail: the Gradio API of a public Space, called with gradio_client.Client(space_id, token=...).predict()
tooling: gradio_client (pip install --upgrade gradio_client); huggingface_hub for the token
chaining: the hosting side of the same GPU pool is recorded at compute/huggingface-spaces-zerogpu; duplicating a Space to a private one moves the cost to the caller's account

limits.value: 2 minutes of GPU a day unauthenticated (queue priority Low) and 5 minutes a day on a free account (Medium); PRO is 40 minutes
a public Space used as an API may be rate limited by Hugging Face if too many requests are made; no number is published

binding_note: minutes of GPU a day bind long before any request count does

identity_cost.detail: the Unauthenticated tier needs no account and gets 2 minutes a day; a free Hugging Face account is the 5-minute tier. What a free account signup requires is unverified on the pages read

reliability_note: quota left lowers queue priority, and whether a gradio_client call made with a token is counted against that account's quota is not stated on the pages read
confidence_note: the daily quota table is quoted from the vendor documentation; no Space was called

evidence.quote: ZeroGPU Spaces are available to use for free to all users.
evidence.proved: ZeroGPU Spaces are free to use for all users
unauthenticated use gets 2 minutes of GPU a day at low queue priority
a free account gets 5 minutes of GPU a day at medium queue priority

evidence.quote: Included daily quota resets exactly 24 hours after your first GPU usage.
evidence.proved: the daily quota resets 24 hours after the first GPU use

evidence.quote: While you can use any public Space as an API, you may get rate limited by Hugging Face if you make too many requests.
evidence.proved: a public Space can be used as an API through the Gradio client and may be rate limited
the Gradio client takes a Hugging Face token with the token parameter

notes: Whether the Gradio API path draws on the same daily quota as the web page is unverified.
